report:
admin-a is done: the separate admin app under /admin, plus the API additions it needed. All checks pass. Every screen loads real API data and was screenshotted against my own API (port 4106) and web build (port 3106). Both servers are stopped. Nothing was committed.

WHAT WAS BUILT
Web routes (apps/web/src/app/admin/):
- /admin/login: ADM-01, no shell.
- The (console) group: session guard plus shell, covering /admin (ADM-02), /admin/approvals (ADM-00 inbox, ADM-X1), /admin/alerts (MOB-11), /admin/users (U1), and /admin/users/[id] with 9 tab routes (summary, account, wallets, kyc, aml, transactions, restrictions, responsible-gaming, audit = U2–U10).
- /admin/audit (S3), /admin/roles (S1), /admin/permissions (S2), /admin/no-access (ADM-00 no-permission).
- A [...slug] catch-all shows an honest "not in this build" state. admin-b's static /admin/finance|pool|compliance routes take precedence and render inside my shell.

Web components (apps/web/src/components/admin-a/):
- session.tsx: AdminSessionProvider / useAdminSession. Calls setAdminTokenProvider. Access JWT is kept in memory and the rotating refresh token in sessionStorage. Single-flight refresh, a 15-minute idle timeout with a 2-minute "Still there?" warning (only "Stay signed in" extends it), and a 401 means the session is over.
- shell.tsx: sidebar 248 px with the 10 groups, lock / no-access state, live counts and signed-in card. Topbar with environment badge, ⌘K trigger, approvals count and alerts count. Drawer below 1280 px. Mobile top bar plus Admin Tab Bar below 768 px. Session timeout dialog.
- command-palette.tsx (pages, player search, user action shortcuts), nav-config.ts (admin-b added its children to it), login.tsx, overview.tsx, approvals.tsx, alerts.tsx, users-list.tsx, user-detail.tsx, user-tabs.tsx, user-restrictions.tsx, audit.tsx, roles.tsx, no-access.tsx.
- four-eyes.tsx:
  - ConfirmWithReasonDialog: reason category, reason and a fresh 2FA code. Default/ready/error/submitted states, AR reference shown.
  - ApprovalReviewDialog: second approver, self-approval blocked, decision trail, and "external" requests from other modules.
- primitives.tsx and hooks.ts.
- API wrappers: apps/web/src/lib/api/admin-a.ts, all using apiRequest with auth 'admin'.
- Tests and tooling: test/admin-a.test.tsx (10 unit tests), e2e/admin-a.spec.ts, scripts/admin-a-qa.mjs (screenshot QA).

API (apps/api/src/modules/admin/):
- New: four-eyes.service.ts, admin-console.service.ts, admin-console.controller.ts, admin-console.spec.ts.
- Additive edits: admin.module.ts, admin.service.ts (user filters, ledger balance and AML risk per row, four-eyes restriction branch), admin.controller.ts (shared DTOs).
- New endpoints:
  - Four-eyes: GET /admin/approvals/inbox and /admin/approvals/:id; POST /admin/approvals/:id/approve, /reject and /withdraw.
  - Users: GET /admin/user-stats; GET /admin/users/:id/account, /wallets, /kyc, /aml, /transactions and /responsible-gaming; POST /admin/users/:id/pii/reveal.
  - Roles and system: GET /admin/roles and /admin/permissions; POST /admin/roles/:key/change-requests; GET /admin/system/health; GET /admin/alerts; POST /admin/alerts/:key/ack.
- Extended GET /admin/users with status, kycLevel and restricted filters.
- Tests: test/admin-console.e2e-spec.ts (9 e2e tests).
- Shared package: enums.ts additive (restriction types and labels, RESTRICTION_REQUIRES_FOUR_EYES, FOUR_EYES_EXPIRY_HOURS, approval statuses, FOUR_EYES_ACTION_PERMISSION, PERMISSION_LABEL), new schemas/admin-console.ts, one export line in schemas/index.ts.
- Docs: admin console section added to docs/API.md and docs/WEB_COMPONENTS.md.
- No result, winner, payout, ledger-edit or balance-adjust path exists. Restrictions never touch balances. Requests owned by other modules (admin-b's pool.entries.pause/resume breaker) are listed with a link to their own page; the approve/reject endpoints here refuse them with a 400 (handled admin-b's note #56).

VERIFICATION (exact results)
- Web: typecheck exit 0, lint exit 0, test 10 files / 95 tests passed.
- Web build: `flock /tmp/gp-web-build.lock env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-admin-a NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4106 NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=api NEXT_PUBLIC_STATE_PREVIEW=true pnpm --filter @gp/web build` exited 0 on the final source.
- Web e2e: e2e/admin-a.spec.ts 2/2 passed. Flow: K. Osei signs in through the UI (password then TOTP) → Overview → Users search → player → Restrictions → "Withdrawals on hold" with reason and 2FA → AR request created, nothing applied yet → self-approval blocked → S. Iyer signs in → Approvals → approves with own reason and 2FA → restriction active → audit chain intact. The second test checks that a signed-out visitor is redirected to sign-in.
- API: typecheck exit 0, lint exit 0. Full `pnpm --filter @gp/api test`: unit 14 files / 59 tests, e2e 13 files / 100 tests, all passed.
  - That includes admin-console.e2e 9/9 (four-eyes request, self-approval, wrong role, approve/reject/withdraw/expiry, protective restriction applies immediately, PII reveal audited without storing the value, tab permissions, role change needs two Super Admins, health and alerts with acknowledgement, external breaker requests).
  - One pre-existing test in admin.e2e-spec.ts failed on the first run: it assumed its new withdrawal was on page 1 of 20 in the shared test DB, which now holds 37 open withdrawals. I changed it to read the first and last page; it passes now.
- Shared package: build and typecheck OK.
- Screenshots in apps/web/test-results/visual/admin-a/: no horizontal overflow and no console errors in the QA runs.
  - S. Iyer: 1440 and 390 for all 16 pages; 1280 and 768 for overview, approvals, users, user summary, restrictions and audit.
  - Login: default, error, 2FA, locked, session-ended and blocked at 1440, 768 and 390.
  - Command palette; timeout warning at 1440 and 390.
  - R. Duarte (Support): overview with financial KPIs hidden, roles page, AML tab and no-access page.
  - e2e_X1_* captures of the apply, submitted, self-blocked, review and approved states.
- Figma: I fetched 10 frames, saved in design/reference/admin-a/: ADM-00 approvals inbox, command palette and no-permission; ADM-01 sign-in; ADM-02 overview; U1; U2; U3; U8 apply; X1 second-approver review. The seat hit its rate limit several times; I retried later. I compared the 1440 renders with these. Layout, copy and structure match closely; the deviations are listed per ledger row.

failing: None of the admin-a checks fail.

Fixed: one assertion in the shared apps/api/test/admin.e2e-spec.ts ('flagged withdrawals need FOUR EYES') failed once because it only read page 1 of 20 while the shared test DB now holds 37 open withdrawals. It now reads the first and last page; the full API suite passes.
decisions: Business rule I chose: withdrawals_frozen and account_suspended need four eyes (RESTRICTION_REQUIRES_FOUR_EYES). POST /admin/users/:id/restrictions then answers 201 {status:'pending_approval', approval} and nothing changes until a different admin with users.restrict approves. gaming_blocked and deposits_blocked still apply immediately (now with status:'active'). Lifting never needs a second approver. Please confirm.

Four-eyes requests expire after 4 h (FOUR_EYES_EXPIRY_HOURS). Expiry happens when the inbox or a request is next read and writes a system audit row. Requests owned by other modules are never expired or executed here.
Approval references are 'AR-' plus the first 6 hex characters of the UUID; display only, the API has no sequence number.

AML risk score is a rule-based model I defined (open alert weights: low 5, medium 15, high 30, critical 50; closed alerts in 90 days; KYC level; account age; active restrictions; capped at 100; bands 30/60/85). It is read-only and shown with its breakdown. Please confirm or replace with the real provider score.
PII reveal: one field at a time (email, date of birth, last sign-in IP), needs users.pii.read and a reason, is audit-logged without the value, and is shown for 60 s.

Role-permission changes are requests only (admins.manage, reason + MFA), one role per request because 2FA codes are single-use. The Super Admin role cannot be changed. With only one seeded Super Admin, a second Super Admin must exist before any change can be approved.

Alerts are computed from real state (ledger reconciliation, services, queues, kill switches, pending VRF requests, failed withdrawals, AML, reviews, KYC) and filtered by role. Acknowledging writes an audit row and changes nothing else.
Admin token storage: access JWT in memory, rotating refresh token in sessionStorage (tab-scoped). An httpOnly cookie would be safer for production.

Login is a two-step UI but makes one /admin/auth/login call with a single generic error, so it never reveals which part was wrong. Security key and 'trust device' are omitted rather than shown as fake buttons.
Overview hides financial panels for roles without ledger.read and without withdrawals.approve (e.g. Support, Marketing), as in the Figma restricted-role state.
Admin player-ID routes read the id with useParams on the client. Typed layout params broke typecheck through other agents' stale generated .next-*/types folders.
next: Product decisions for the owner: confirm which restriction types need four eyes and how long requests stay open; confirm or replace the AML risk score model.

Missing API endpoints so the remaining Figma details can be built: case notes, user data export, admin end-session / 2FA reset requests, KYC documents, timed restriction durations, AML score history (for the 90-day chart), 'remind approvers', previous-period KPI deltas (for overview trend lines), richer palette search (transactions, rounds).
Admin WebAuthn security keys and a network IP allow-list (would make the 'blocked network' state real); refresh token in an httpOnly cookie.
Seed a second Super Admin so role-change requests can actually be approved in DEMO.

Run the pending Figma scripts in design/figma-build/pending/adm-core (laptop, tablet and mobile frames for ADM-00/01/02/X1 and MOB-11 were never built); my 1280/768/390 layouts follow the build notes, not finished frames.
Optional for MOB-11: show the approval review as a bottom sheet below 768 px.

Memory candidates (learned this session): Figma MCP get_screenshot hits the seat limit often and needs minutes between bursts; with about 7 parallel agents, `next dev` gets OOM-killed, so serve flock'ed `next start` builds for QA; the API listens on API_PORT, not PORT; DEMO admin TOTP codes are replay-protected per time step, so agents logging in as the same DEMO admin can collide.

report:
admin-b is built and verified: Finance (ADM-F1…F9), Global Pool monitoring (ADM-P1…P10) and Compliance KYC/AML (ADM-C1, ADM-C2). The pages run inside admin-a's console shell, against the real API.

API — new module apps/api/src/modules/admin-ops/:
- Controllers: admin/finance, admin/pool, admin/compliance (21 new operations).
- Services: finance, pool, compliance, exports, plus csv.ts with csv.spec.ts.
- Shared contracts: packages/shared/src/schemas/admin-ops.ts, exported from schemas/index.ts.
- Read endpoints are aggregates of the append-only ledger and its sub-ledgers.
- The only writes are reviewed and audited (written reason; fresh 2FA except CSV exports and refund reminders, which take a reason only; hash-chained audit row):
  - CSV export (reason; personal data needs users.pii.read; 500,000-row limit; SHA-256; watermark line).
  - Refund reminder: an in-app notice only, at most 1 per round per 24 h.
  - NEW-entries circuit breaker: request, then a second approver of a different role, then the `pool.entries.enabled` flag flips. Requests expire after 30 min.
  - KYC decision: approve / reject / request info, with reason and fresh 2FA; the player is notified.
- Withdrawal approve/reject and AML resolve reuse the existing endpoints.
- Calls such as `PATCH /admin/finance/ledger/:id`, `POST /admin/pool/rounds/:n/winners` and a manual refund return 404, covered by e2e.

Web:
- apps/web/src/lib/api/admin-b.ts: types, TanStack Query hooks and mutations over apiRequest (auth: 'admin').
- apps/web/src/components/admin-b/: primitives (header with module sub-nav, KPI tile, panel, data table with phone card mode, pagination, filter chips, risk meter, bar chart, Immutable panel), reason dialog (Dialog on tablet+, bottom Sheet on phone; RHF + shared zod), export dialog, and finance/, pool/, compliance/ pages.

decisions: Circuit breaker (ADM-P10), per the Figma spec: Super Admin, Finance or Compliance may request; the second approver must be a different person holding a different one of those roles; 2FA for both; requests expire after 30 min; resume uses the same flow. It is role-based (checks AuthAdmin.roles), not permission-based, because RBAC is DB-driven and no single permission maps to it. Approval rows use action pool.entries.pause/resume, targetType feature_flag. Task note #56 asks admin-a to link these from their inbox rather than offer approve/reject there.

Platform fees of cancelled rounds are shown as retained in the fees account (stakes are refunded in full), as the existing ledger posting rules define. The Figma copy says 'fee released'. Owner decision needed.
KYC decisions require a fresh 2FA code, which is stricter than the REASON-only policy for kyc.review.

CSV exports: reason required; personal data masked unless users.pii.read (Finance cannot include it); CSV returned inline and downloaded client-side, with no file storage, so 'link expires' is nominal; audit action report.exported carries the SHA-256.
Refund reminders need notifications.send (Super Admin, Marketing). The Figma implies Finance can remind. Owner decision needed.
The ledger hash chain is computed on read (sha256 over all postings in commit order), not stored per entry and not anchored on-chain. The audit log keeps its own stored chain.
Bulk withdrawal approval is deliberately not offered; every request is decided on its own detail page.

Shared-file changes, all additive: admin.module.ts exports AdminAuthService, AdminSecurityService and the guards; FeatureFlagsService.invalidate(); app.module.ts registers AdminOpsModule; shared schemas/admin-ops.ts plus its export line; admin-a nav-config.ts gets Finance/Pool/Compliance children; docs/API.md gets an admin-ops section. Prettier also ran over the whole app/admin/(console) folder, which includes admin-a's files; this should only be formatting.

Dev DB: ran `pnpm --filter @gp/api db:migrate:deploy` (non-destructive), which applied api-gaps' finished migration 20261128163000_randomness_request_scope so the API could run. Added DEMO, non-ledger compliance cases with prisma/seed-admin-ops.ts (10 KYC cases, 5 AML alerts, idempotent).
Seeded DEMO times (18:40 UTC on 28 Nov) are ahead of the real clock, so some SLA and age values read oddly (e.g. 17 h left, 'just now'). These are data artefacts, not UI bugs.
